title: Demarked: A Strategy for Enhanced Abusive Speech Moderation through Counterspeech, Detoxification, and Message Management

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of social media platforms used as data sources across 38 hate speech datasets to identify the over-representation of specific platforms (e.g., X/Twitter) relative to their actual global user base.

Surveying hate speech dataset papers through a questionnaire to evaluate whether they report key annotator demographics (such as age, gender, religion, and race) to assess dataset inclusivity and annotator suitability.
